def count_detected_objects(image_path, labels, threshold, model_size, padding):
    import Image
    import ground_dino

    # Open the image
    img = Image.open(image_path)

    # Create an Object Detector object
    detector = ground_dino.ground_dino()

    # Detect objects in the image
    detections = detector.detect(img, labels=labels, threshold=threshold, model_size=model_size, padding=padding)

    # Return the count of detected objects
    return len(detections)
